s: a cycling café inside the former largest carpet mill in the world
w: The fourth café bar from local operator MAMIL, set on the ground floor of Dean Clough's main mill building -- once, in the 19th century, the largest carpet factory on earth, now reinvented as studios, bars and offices. Coffee and brunch built around a cycling theme in a genuinely vast, repurposed industrial shell.
_facts: Located within Dean Clough, Halifax HX3 5AX, West Yorkshire
Fourth café bar opened by local operator MAMIL
Dean Clough was formerly the largest carpet factory in the world, now a mixed-use creative and business complex
Cycling-themed café serving coffee and brunch
